svg.title: Contribution reactor
svg.desc: Contribution reactor: the last year drawn as 366 light-rays spun out from a glowing core, each ray longer and brighter for a busier day, with month spokes and a radar sweep. 1,408 contributions, 182 active days, busiest May 17 with 55.

g.text: $ reactor --spin 366d # one ray per day, out from the core
